column1: # .github/image-sources.tsv — every place in this tree that produces a
# container image reference, and the rule it is held to.
# A tile from a signed catalog bundle is digest-pinned and checked by
# tileschema.ValidateImagePin. The platform sidecars are not: they carry tag
# defaults with environment overrides that pass through no validator at all.
# That is two rules for one kind of value, and until this file existed nothing
# This file does not close the gap — pinning the platform images by digest per
# architecture is its own work. It makes the gap countable and stops it
# growing: a source that is neither `validated` nor `pending` fails the test in
# api/internal/catalog/parity_test.go, so a third rule cannot arrive without
#   validated  the reference passes tileschema.ValidateImagePin before use.
#   pending    it does not yet. `cite` names the issue that will make it.
# The test also fails on a row whose code no longer exists, because a row that
# outlives its source makes the validated count read higher than it is.
